# Quick Brief: Exit-Ticket Frequency Decision

## Summary

The team must decide by Friday whether to run exit tickets daily or weekly this term. Daily two-question exit tickets improve retention of covered material [2]. Completion stays under three minutes when the ticket holds two questions [3]. Weekly checks suit content that changes little between lessons [1]. The deciding factor is how often new material introduces confusion, and the retention data favours the daily cadence with a strict question cap.

## Key Points

- Daily two-question exit tickets improve retention of covered material [2].
- Completion stays under three minutes when the ticket holds two questions [3].
- Weekly checks suit content that changes little between lessons [1].
- The deciding factor is how often new material introduces confusion.

## Action Items

- Adopt daily exit tickets with a maximum of two questions.
- Review the weekly aggregate every Friday during planning period.
- Revisit the decision at half term with the retention data.
